description_en: Queries the storage details of each storage medium for a specific new-architecture Lindorm instance
description_zh: 获取某个具体的Lindorm新架构实例下各个存储介质的存储详情
name: GetLindormV2StorageUsage

AccessDeniedDetail.description_en: The detailed reason for the access denial
AccessDeniedDetail.description_zh: 访问被拒绝的详细原因

CapacityByDiskCategory.description_en: The capacity information of each storage medium
CapacityByDiskCategory.description_zh: 各存储介质的容量信息

items.description_en:
mode: The storage pattern. Valid values:
LOCAL_DISK: local disk
CLOUD_DISK: cloud disk
REMOTE_STORAGE: storage-optimized or archive cloud storage
CLOUD_STORAGE: compute-optimized instance or standard cloud storage
category: The storage type. Valid values:
LOCAL_HDD: local HDD
LOCAL_SSD: local standard SSD
CLOUD_ESSD: ESSD cloud disk
CLOUD_ESSD_PL1: ESSD PL1 cloud disk
CLOUD_EFFICIENCY: ultra disk
STD_CLOUD_ESSD_PL0: standard cloud storage (ESSD PL0)
PERF_CLOUD_ESSD_PL1: compute-optimized instance cloud storage (ESSD PL1) 
REMOTE_CAP_OSS: remote storage-optimized OSS
REMOTE_ARCHIVE_OSS: remote archive OSS
BACKUP_OSS: backup capacity
perfLevel: The cloud disk performance level. Valid values:
PL0
PL1
PL2
PL3
AUTO
capacity: The total capacity. Unit: GiB.
usedCapacity: The used capacity. Unit: GiB
items.description_zh:
mode  存储模式，取值：
LOCAL_DISK 本地盘
CLOUD_DISK 云盘
REMOTE_STORAGE 容量型/归档型 云存储
CLOUD_STORAGE 性能型/标准型 云存储
category  存储类型，取值：
LOCAL_HDD 本地HDD盘
LOCAL_SSD 本地SSD盘
CLOUD_ESSD ESSD云盘
CLOUD_ESSD_PL1  ESSD_PL1云盘
CLOUD_EFFICIENCY  高效云盘
STD_CLOUD_ESSD_PL0  标准型云存储(ESSD_PL0)
PERF_CLOUD_ESSD_PL1  性能型云存储(ESSD_PL1) 
REMOTE_CAP_OSS 远端容量型OSS
REMOTE_ARCHIVE_OSS  远端归档型OSS
BACKUP_OSS  备份容量
perfLevel  云盘性能等级，取值：
PL0
PL1
PL2
PL3
AUTO
capacity  总容量 (单位: GiB)
usedCapacity  已使用容量 (单位: GiB)

UsageByDiskCategory.description_zh: 各存储介质的水位信息

LOCAL_HDD_STORAGE: local HDD

FOREIGN_BUFFER_STORAGE: local cache cloud disk for capacity cloud storage
LOCAL_EBS_STORAGE_EFFECTIVE: local ultra data cloud disk
LOCAL_EBS_STORAGE_PL0: local PL0 data cloud disk
LOCAL_EBS_STORAGE_PL1: local PL1 data cloud disk
LOCAL_EBS_STORAGE_PL2: local PL2 data cloud disk
LOCAL_EBS_STORAGE_PL3: local PL3 data cloud disk
